pm_exper_user_4079_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: What are some fun outdoor activities I could try to make the most of the warm weather this year?
pm_exper_user_4079_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) Since you enjoy swimming in the summer, you might combine beach swims at Jericho with afternoons watching or playing a game of cricket in the park. It’s a great way to balance active water time with a sport that connects you with others and the season.
(b) Given that taking a dip is one of your favorite ways to spend the summer, you might plan some open-water swims at English Bay, coupled with relaxing afternoons paddling or floating near the shore. Pairing these with evening walks by the seawall can really round out your warm-weather days.
(c) You could try a mix of outdoor activities like hiking local trails, cycling around the city, or having a picnic in your favorite park. These options are simple, relaxing ways to get fresh air and enjoy the summer sunshine.
(d) Since you enjoy swimming in the summer, you could mix regular visits to Kitsilano Pool with weekend sessions of stand-up paddleboarding or kayaking along False Creek. Adding in a scenic bike ride before or after can make the most of the warm weather while staying active.
